FanDuel.dnp: For player prop markets, only when a player does not play a snap in that game are the selections voided.
FanDuel.whole_number: In Point Spread (Handicap) & Total betting, where the index (value) of the market is a whole number, bets are void and will be refunded where the score lands on that number. (game-level; prop push = inference)
FanDuel.parlay_sgp: If all selections except one are void, the parlays will be settled as a straight at the applicable odds. - The above also applies to all Same Game Parlay bets

FL.quote: Can I legally place online wagers on sports? Generally, no. Unless you are placing a wager through sportsbooks operated by or in conjunction with the Seminole Tribe of Florida, you are most likely placing an illegal wager.
FL.note: Only Seminole-operated (Hard Rock Bet) per regulator; not widened

TX.quote: Section 47.02 of the Texas Penal Code states someone commits an offense if they: make a bet on the partial or final result of a game or contest or on the performance of a participant in a game or contest
